provenance: Codex subagent review of immutable prepared inputs; findings checked against source, separate from deterministic validation.
rationale: The diagram vocabulary is introduced here: graph facts, nodes and slots each have clear named passages. Aliases, initial empty slots and the boundary from language semantics are stated locally. No language formula is used. α or edge-style examples elsewhere are diagram identifiers, while this unit defines the available fact constructors.
limitations: Editorial inspection of retained prose, math, exact link inventory, source/target context and policy. This is not a proof that no conceivable explanatory link is missing, and the reviewer also implemented the audit validator; no independent-author status is claimed.
